name: Aksharantar (AI4Bharat), Hindi
licence_source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/Aksharantar/blob/main/README.md (Licensing Information: the mined data is packaged under CC0, and AI4Bharat waives all rights to the manually collected data); paper arXiv:2205.03018 §1: "the Aksharantar benchmark and all data we created manually are available under the CC-BY license, whereas all the mined data is available under the CC0 license." As for Malayalam (aksharantar.json), only rows whose source is mined (IndicCorp, Samanantar), Wikidata or AI4Bharat's own manual collection (AK-*) are used; Dakshina rows (CC BY-SA 4.0, taken from the Dakshina release instead) and 'Existing sources' rows (licence not traced) are dropped.
attribution: Aksharantar by AI4Bharat (Madhani et al., 2022), CC BY and CC0. Includes names from Wikidata (CC0).
verdict_reason: Same filter as the Malayalam release: keep IndicCorp (mining score >= -0.2), Samanantar, Wikidata and AK-* rows; drop Dakshina and Existing rows.
used_for: hin_train.json rows from the kept sources, as Hindi transliterator training pairs (training/mlkb/data/human.py with --lang hi), minus every Dakshina hi dev/test word. hin_valid.json and hin_test.json are not used. The mined rows (IndicCorp, Samanantar) also mark English loanwords in the Hindi LM's synthetic Hinglish text (training/mlkb/lm/corpus.py --lang hi). The Bhojpuri pack (packs/bho.neopack) has no human pairs of its own (Aksharantar and Dakshina have no Bhojpuri), so it uses these Hindi files through the Aksharantar path of training/mlkb/langs (data/langs/bho/lang.json says "aksharantar": "hin"), with the same filter: a quarter of hin_train.json's AK-Freq rows fit the Bhojpuri tables (and would validate training), its mined and Wikidata rows would be a Bhojpuri transliterator's pairs beside Bhojpuri's own synthetic ones (not trained yet: the pack carries the Hindi pack's transliterator), and hin_test.json's manual rows (AK-Freq 3,647, AK-NEI 1,188, AK-NEF 826) as data/eval/bho/translit-human.tsv, which is a Hindi set.
notes: Fetched 2026-11-06. Extract with: unzip hin.zip -d data/raw/aksharantar-hin/extracted. hin_train.json has 1,299,155 rows: IndicCorp 956,190, Samanantar 152,778, Existing 131,773, Dakshina 24,727, Wikidata 24,528, AK-Freq 9,159. Existing and Dakshina rows are dropped for licence. The CC0 statement says 'We do not own any of the text from which this data has been extracted': mined pairs are single words, which we treat as unprotectable on their own.
status: in packs/hi.neopack, a download (credited in its manifest), not in the app; also in packs/bho.neopack, not listed on the download site yet
